name: Night Shift
hint: One lantern, one timer, three pits you cannot see. Stay in the light.
why4: The plate needs a pile of three on its one-tile pillar while the fourth carries the lantern through gate E to fetch the key.
solution: P1 grabs the lantern at x=7 and leads (light radius 5). Everyone gathers at x=9-11.
P2 touches the button at x=10: gate A at x=34 opens for 10 s. All run right behind P1, jumping the pits at x=14-15, x=20-22 and x=27-28, and pass the gate (25 tiles, about 4.5 s with the jumps).
Pile on the 1-wide pillar at x=41: P2 jumps onto the plate; P3 jumps onto P2's head; P4 hops onto the step at x=43-44 and jumps onto P3's head (3/3): gate E at x=47 opens.

P1 (with the lantern) walks through gate E, jumps the 3-wide pit at x=50-52, sets the lantern down by the key (Down+Grab: the key only jumps into empty hands), touches the key at x=56 and comes back through gate E.
P1 opens the door at x=38; the pile climbs down; all press Down.

Recovery: anyone popped respawns at the start: a friend beyond gate A touches the button at x=36 (hold 10) while they press x=10 and run. A lantern lost in a pit returns to x=7; same trick to fetch it.
